@topic eco-elasticity

Q: The price of a good rises from ₦80 to ₦120 and quantity demanded falls from 500 to 350 units. What is the price elasticity of demand?
A: 0.6 (inelastic)
W: 1.67 (elastic)
W: 30 (elastic)
W: 1.2 (elastic)
E: % change in quantity = 30%; % change in price = 50%. PED = 30 ÷ 50 = 0.6, so demand is inelastic.

Q: A firm produces 40 units at a total cost of ₦4,800. What is its average cost?
A: ₦120
W: ₦192,000
W: ₦4,760
W: ₦2,400
E: AC = TC ÷ output = ₦4,800 ÷ 40 = ₦120.

@topic eco-national-income

Q: A country's national income is ₦12,000 million and its population is 20 million. Find the income per head.
A: ₦600
W: ₦240,000
W: ₦11,980
W: ₦6,000
E: Per capita income = national income ÷ population = 12,000 ÷ 20 = ₦600.
